translation.name: Kitap molinas men ringkat na alaata'ala: perjanjian baru

book.name: Wahyu
book.title: WAHYU Men ia Piile' I Yohanes

content: Mbaka' yaku' piile' Anak Domba iya'a nanganuimo segel men olukon na segel men pipitu' iya'a. Kasi yaku' nongorongor wurungna sa'angu' siinsiing men tonsoop papaat siinsiing iya'a norobu men tamban kumokurung taena, “Mai!”

Mbaka' yaku' piile' isian sa'angu' kuda bubulak. Mian men nangalakiti, ninginton pana' ka' i ia nitarai songko'na tomundo'. Kasi ia no'umuar koi mian men nungurungku'imo timbangna ka' mae' poopapate soosoodo mampari-pari mungurungku'i.
Ka' tempo Anak Domba iya'a nanganui segel men korua'na, yaku' nongorongor siinsiing men korua'na norobu taena, “Mai!”

Mbaka' no'umuarmo a sa'angu' kuda men sambanaan. Kuda iya'a memea' mandiirak ka' men nangalakiti nitarai kuasa bo pompopenta' pooka'amatan na tano' balaki' pataka ninsidakon mian poopapate ka' na ko'ona nitarai sa'angu' sinangkidi men balaki'.

Ka' tempo Anak Domba iya'a nanganui segel men kotolu'na, yaku' rongor siinsiing men kotolu'na norobu taena, “Mai!” Mbaka' yaku' piile' isian kuda mo'itom ka' mian men nangalakiti ninginton timbangan sa'angu'.

Ka' yaku' rongor koi se' isian wurung na tanga-tanga'na siinsiing papaat iya'a mangaan taena, “Sa'angu' liter gandum men pore, ilina koi tambona mian balimang sangilio, ka' tolu' liter jelai, uga' ilina koi tambona mian men balimang sangilio. Kasee alia mambaraba'i kau saitun tia ale'na anggur iya'a.”
Ka' sarataa Anak Domba iya'a nanganui segel men kopaatna, yaku' rongor siinsiing men kopaatna norobu taena, “Mai!”

Yaku' piile' isian sa'angu' kuda men mampelas a wuluna, ka' men nangalakiti, ngaanna i Kolapusan, ka' na komburi'na ia tuntuni dodongoanna mian lapus. Ka' i raaya'a nitarai kuasa bo mampapatei mian koi sangobosan na lalomna papaat obosan na tano' balaki' kani'i tia sinangkidi, pololuan, nggeo ka' tia ayop na tano' balaki' men mangkaan antok mamata'.
Ka' tempo Anak Domba iya'a nanganui segel men kolima'na, yaku' piile' na intuna mesba isian santuo'na mian men nipapatei gause i raaya'a malolo' tuu' mengelelekon wurungna Alaata'ala.

Raaya'a mangkakaro' men tamban lansoongan taena, “Oo Tumpu men pungkuasai ka' molinas ka' men kana'! Dauga' koi upa a nau'na kasi i Kuu mungukumi mian men na tano' balaki' ka' mungukum i raaya'a gause nampapateimo i kai?”

Ka' na giigii' santuo' iya'a nitarai juba men bubulak, ka' nibantilkon se' i raaya'a tio mintimale titiu' pataka sampa a saa'na simbaya'na i raaya'a men balimang na Tumpu ka' utusna sa'angu' kaparasaya'an papateionna mian, koi i raaya'a nipapatei.
Kasi yaku' nimiile' Anak Domba iya'a nanganui segel men konoomna. Mbaka' nolili'onmo men dodoa tuu' ka' matana ilio no'itommo, somo koi toik mo'itom, ka' wulan nopemea'mo, somo koi rara'.
Bitu'on na langit marandak na tano' balaki', koi woo'na kau ara men dauga' mamata' marandak puuronna mombuul men makorong.
Ka' langit nokumonsormo koi kitap nilulun ka' buu'na tia togong notonsaalmo na kekelaanna.

Ka' giigii' tomundo' na tano' balaki' ka' mian moola' tia tanaasna surudadu ka' mian men kupangon tia giigii' mian men tongaan ka' giigii' ata' tia mian men sianta nipo'ata', ninsapitmo na lalomna leeng ka' na selengkakna watu.
Raaya'a nomorobui buu'na ka' watu iya'a taena, “Bi koruntun mangkana'i i kai ka' sapitkon i kai dako' piile'on-Na men no'umoruang na oruangan kobalaki'an ka' kana'onna maso'na Anak Domba iya'a.
Gause takamo a ilio kolayaon men komaso'anna Alaata'ala tia Anak Domba, ka' sianta sa'angu'po mian men daa mokotaan!”
